// WHAT THIS IS: The ONE config file for src/orchestration. Three sections: `assets` (which modules load, grouped and gated), `partitions` (which sub-modules each partitioned asset offers), and `run` (the config the trading_view_full_refresh job carries). Replaced assets_enabled.json + tv_full_refresh.yaml on 2026-08-05.
// ABSENT MEANS OFF: Changed 2026-08-05, and it is the opposite of what this file used to do. Nothing loads unless it says true. The friendly default -- absent = on -- is the one under which a 777-ticker scrape or a 2.4-hour OCR parse joins a run because nobody wrote a line about it.
// EVERY MODULE MUST BE LISTED: Because absent is off, an asset missing from this file would vanish from the UI with nothing saying so. The loader RAISES on any asset in the graph that has no entry here, so adding an asset forces a yes or no.
// HIERARCHY: THE GROUP GATE: Each group is an object holding `enabled` plus its modules. A module loads only if BOTH its group's `enabled` and its own value are true, so one line switches off a whole layer while every module stays visible. Same rule as switch_config.json, where every ancestor must be true. A bare `"cafef": false` is REJECTED - write `"cafef": {"enabled": false, ...}` so the modules remain listed.
// COMMENTS: Any key starting with // is a comment and is ignored, the same convention switch_config.json uses. JSON has no comment syntax; this is the substitute.
// A TYPO IS AN ERROR: A key naming no asset and no partition RAISES at load time, listing the valid ones. A silently-ignored key is the exact failure switch_config.json's trailing-slash bug had: the file said a thing was off, the loader never matched it, and it ran anyway.
// PARTITIONS ARE SUB-MODULES: A partition that is not true is REMOVED from the asset's PartitionsDefinition: it cannot be materialized, cannot be backfilled, is not in the UI, and --partition <it> fails with DagsterUnknownPartitionError before any work starts. Stronger than not selecting it, and it is what stops a backfill taking everything. NOTE the one asymmetry: absent-inside-a-listed-owner is OFF, but an owner mentioned NOWHERE is 'no opinion' and keeps all its partitions -- otherwise raw/cafef_pdfs' 100 unlisted tickers would resolve to zero partitions and raise at import.
// PARTITION OWNERS: The key under `partitions` is the partition set's OWNER, which is not always an asset. Assets sharing one PartitionsDefinition share its toggles: `raw/trading_view` covers trading_view_links AND trading_view_data (the data step reads the link CSV its own partition wrote, so they cannot disagree), and `unified` covers all ten pool__* assets. Sets owned by a single asset keep that asset's key: raw/cafef_pdfs, raw/cafef_financials. Owners not listed here have every partition enabled.
// YOU CANNOT DISABLE THEM ALL: If every partition of one owner is false the load RAISES: an asset with zero partitions is unmaterializable in a way that reads as a Dagster bug. To switch the whole thing off, use its `assets` key.
// EVERYTHING IS ON (2026-08-06): All 80 assets and all partitions are true, so every module is visible and selectable in the UI. This is the file doing its intended job: SELECTION is the run plan (level 1 of `Turning things off`), and hard-disabling here is reserved for `must never load in this repo`. What you do not select does not run.
// ...WHICH RE-ARMS ONE FOOTGUN: `Materialize all`, `*`, or a backfill over a partitioned asset now takes EVERY partition -- raw/cafef_pdfs is 100 tickers at ~1-1.7 GB each, raw/trading_view @stocks is 777 tickers at ~10 h, raw/cafef_financials is ~2.4 h per ticker. Materialize a GROUP or a named asset, never the whole graph. If a backfill does run away, set the partitions false here: that removes them from the PartitionsDefinition entirely, which is the only lever that stops it before any work starts.

assets.// ---- trading_view ----: TRADINGVIEW - the universe (links) then the OHLCV (data). 9 asset-class partitions; see `partitions` for which are on.

trading_view.// enabled: ON. The universe (links) then the OHLCV (data). economy is COMPLETE as of 2026-08-06: 3,851/3,851 series, 19/19 countries.
trading_view.// raw/trading_view_collected_links: nothing reads this - an aggregation leaf, kept because the CSV is on disk. Harmless, but there is no reason to select it.
trading_view.// raw/trading_view_data: HEAVY - Selenium, hours per asset class. economy is DONE (3,851 series, 2026-08-06); bonds/funds are minutes, forex is ~7-8 h, stocks is ~10 h.

assets.// ---- cafef ----: CAFEF - the five per-stock daily/event tabs plus the news feed. Every one needs raw/trading_view_links partition `stocks`.

cafef.// enabled: ON, and every asset here needs raw/trading_view_links partition `stocks` on disk first - the five tabs and the news feed all read links/stocks/.
cafef.// raw/cafef_news: HEAVY - ~2 h, ~405k rows over the full universe

assets.// ---- cafef_index ----: CAFEF MARKET INDICES - the same four tabs over 6 fixed index codes. No upstream, minutes to run.

cafef_index.// enabled: ON. Independent of TradingView, minutes to run.

assets.// ---- cafef_filings ----: CAFEF FILINGS - PDF archive then the OCR statement parse. Both partitioned per ticker; ~1-1.7 GB and ~2.4 h EACH.

cafef_filings.// enabled: ON, and this is the expensive group: ~1-1.7 GB per pdfs partition x 100, ~2.4 h per financials partition. Select deliberately.

assets.// ---- simplize ----: SIMPLIZE - the fully dividend-adjusted daily panel and the industry map.

simplize.// enabled: ON. Needs raw/trading_view_links partition `stocks` for its universe.

assets.// ---- gics ----: GICS - MSCI's reference taxonomy. No upstream.

gics.// enabled: ON. No upstream, one xlsx download.

assets.// ---- bronze ----: BRONZE TABLES - raw_data/ -> bronze_schema. 20 ingest leaves, 25 tables. Each reads its own folder; no cross-table dependency.

bronze.// enabled: ON. Reads raw_data/ only - no scrape needed if the folders are populated. ~9 min for all 20, 10.6 M rows.
bronze.// bronze/cafef_financials: writes SIX tables from one ingest
bronze.// bronze/simplize_stocks: 2.7 M rows - the biggest table in the layer

assets.// ---- silver ----: SILVER TABLES - bronze_schema -> silver_schema. The canonical long facts, dimensions and joined panels.

silver.// silver/cafef_financials: ONE method, THREE tables - the per-report statement carry-ups
silver.// silver/cafef_financials_bank: the 3 bank statements carried up, then joined wide per quarter (180 cols)
silver.// silver/stocks_basic_financials_bank: daily x quarterly, as-of on publish_date - INNER, bank tickers only
silver.// silver/cafef_news: 395k articles cleaned + de-duped + ALIGNED TO A SESSION (trading_date is the look-ahead guard); needs silver/stocks_basic for the calendar

assets.// ---- gold ----: GOLD TABLES - silver_schema -> gold_schema. The wide, model-ready panels; every densifying assumption lives here.

gold.// enabled: ON. Reads silver_schema. gold/stocks_ta is hours and ~11 GB - see its own note.
gold.// gold/economy: WIDE: 1 row per business day, 1 col per series, as-of filled
gold.// gold/bonds: 9 tenors x 13 measures = 117 cols; the VN01/VN01Y twins are asserted identical, then collapsed
gold.// gold/funds: 19 HOSE ETFs x up to 19 measures = 351 cols; replaces the long 22-col feature table
gold.// gold/forex: 328 broker-quoted pairs, ONE value column each = 328 cols; no features (328 x 13 would exceed PostgreSQL's 1600-column ceiling)
gold.// gold/stocks: The per-stock price/flow panel, ~2.4M stock-days x ~42 cols, adjusted OHLC, NO derived columns
gold.// gold/stocks_ta: HEAVY - gold/stocks + the ~900-column TA block over 2.4M rows: hours, ~11 GB
gold.// gold/stocks_financials_bank_fa: FEATURE panel: the _fa source + the full TA battery, ~1.1k columns
gold.// gold/news_weekly_panel: 497k ticker-WEEKS, news + event counts, no sentiment - the panel the if_news baseline runs on
gold.// gold/news_daily_panel: DAILY twin of the weekly panel - trailing 5/10-session news windows for rel5/rel10

assets.// ---- unified ----: UNIFIED TABLES - silver_schema -> unified_schema_<universe>. One universe per partition, cut into feature groups.

unified.// enabled: ON. Reads silver/gold into unified_schema_<universe>; pick a partition (VCB / BANK / ALL).
unified.// unified/pool__basic: every column of silver.stocks_basic for the partition's universe, silver's own types
unified.// unified/pool__targets: return_{5,10}day + return_rel_{5,10}day (minus the VNINDEX return over the same window)
unified.// unified/pool__ta: HEAVY on ALL - ~920 technical columns from gold.stocks_ta
unified.// unified/pool__fa: ~204 fundamental columns from gold.stocks_financials_bank_fa - BANK TICKERS ONLY by construction
unified.// unified/pool__economy: All 19 gold.economy_<country> macro panels on pool__basic's trading-day spine; one unified pool table per country because the combined 3,784-series panel exceeds PostgreSQL's 1,600-column limit
unified.// unified/pool__forex: 357 broker-quoted FX pairs from gold.forex on pool__basic's trading-day spine, ONE table (360 columns, inside the 1,600 limit). Same date-only join as pool__economy. NOT forward-filled - median series coverage on VCB's spine is 67%, and 328 of 357 series stop at 2026-06-08/09 until the source is re-scraped with skip_existing=false.
unified.// unified/pool__funds: 21 HOSE ETFs x up to 19 trailing measures = 389 columns from gold.funds, same date-only broadcast join. The source starts 2014-10-06 against a 2009 spine, so 31.7% of VCB rows are NULL by construction and median column coverage is 17.7%. E1VFVN30 is the VN30 index wearing a ticker.
unified.// unified/pool__bonds: 9 VN government tenors x 13 measures = 117 columns from gold.bonds, same date-only broadcast join. THE SLOPE IS THE SIGNAL AND IT IS NOT A COLUMN - vn10y minus vn02y; computing it is the consumer's job. The whole source stops 2026-06-08 uniformly (the scrape queued 0 bond data tasks) and the 15y/20y/30y tenors start in 2018.
unified.// unified/pool__stock_market: 6 VN indices x 27 measures = 162 columns from gold.stock_market (already pivoted there from the four CafeF index tabs), same date-only broadcast join. hose__vnindex__close_adjust IS the benchmark pool__targets subtracts for return_rel_{h}day - no leakage (bm[t], never bm[t+h]) but the target's own denominator becomes a feature. Widest coverage of the family at median 83.1%; the four prop_* measures cover 5.8% and the source ends 2026-07-30.
unified.// unified/pool__basic_bank: The BANK sector's pool__basic measures as PEER CHANNELS: silver.stocks_basic (GICS 401010) pivoted to {exchange}__{ticker}__{measure}, 20 banks x 15 measures = 300 columns, broadcast onto the spine. The only date-broadcast pool with no gold table behind it - the pivot is built on the fly. Membership is derived from GICS and is NOT point-in-time (survivors only). On unified_schema_vcb the schema's OWN ticker is one of the channels, so pool__basic joined to this holds each VCB measure twice.

assets.// ---- analysis ----: ANALYSIS - unified_schema_<universe> -> reports/. The only group here that writes NO database table: feature_selection is read-only by package design, so its output is a run folder on disk that final_features later reads.

analysis.// enabled: ON. One asset, partitioned by COUNTRY (19 keys, read from parameters/trading_view/economy).
analysis.// analysis/feature_selection_economy: One feature selection over pool__basic + pool__economy_<country>. Defaults to a 20-draw null and REFUSES to start if the country pool is behind pool__basic's calendar or if the fitted cost estimate exceeds budget_minutes. usa is ~1,458 channels and raises at the default budget - that is deliberate, see feature_selection/CONTEXT.md 14d.

partitions.// raw/trading_view: THE NINE TRADINGVIEW SCRAPE MODULES, ALL ON as of 2026-08-06 so every one is selectable in the UI. A partition set false here is GONE from the PartitionsDefinition - not merely unselected - so it cannot be backfilled and --partition <it> fails before any work starts. That is the lever to reach for if a backfill ever runs away again.

raw/trading_view.// economy: ON - 19 countries x 11 categories = 209 link leaves, ~3,850 series. The only module currently enabled.
raw/trading_view.// forex: the big one - 2,184 symbols across 47 brokers, ~7-8 h at 4 browsers
raw/trading_view.// stocks: HEAVY - 777 tickers. Also the UNIVERSE every CafeF/Simplize asset reads (links/stocks/), so turn it on before re-scraping those.
raw/trading_view.// futures: vietnam only; every leaf has been empty since June
raw/trading_view.// indices: 50 symbols; gold.indices was retired 2026-08-01, gold/stock_market covers the same six from CafeF at 27 measures
raw/trading_view.// crypto: queues 0 tasks - a bare leaf under `parameters`, no countries beneath it, and its DATA adder is a stub
raw/trading_view.// options: queues 0 tasks; its data adder takes no skip_existing argument, so the partition raises if run

partitions.// raw/cafef_financials: The two tickers whose PDFs are OCR-parsed, ~2.4 h EACH. Both on - select the one you want rather than materializing the asset.
partitions.// unified: The three universes of the unified schema, shared by all ten pool__* assets. Same rule: the group's `enabled` is the off switch, not setting all three false.
partitions.// raw/cafef_pdfs: 100 ticker partitions from vn100.csv, NOT listed here - absent means enabled, and 100 lines of `true` would bury the settings that matter. Disable one with "raw/cafef_pdfs": {"HOSE_VCB": false}.
partitions.// analysis/feature_selection_economy: 19 COUNTRY partitions, NOT listed here for the same reason as raw/cafef_pdfs - and because the list is DERIVED from parameters/trading_view/economy, so listing it again is the drift enabled.py exists to stop. A country enabled for the scrape is a country you can select over. Disable one with "analysis/feature_selection_economy": {"usa": false} - but note that usa already refuses to run at the default budget_minutes, which is the guard you want rather than making it invisible.

parameters.// WHAT THIS IS: The TradingView SCRAPE PARAMETERS - which countries, sectors, brokers and categories each asset class enumerates. Moved here from src/switch_config.json on 2026-08-06; that file is DELETED and enabled.py raises if it comes back.
parameters.// NOT A RUN PLAN: These are parameters, not switches over what runs. What runs is asset SELECTION plus the `assets` and `partitions` sections above. A leaf here only narrows what the selected asset enumerates once it is already running.
parameters.// ONE TREE FOR LINKS AND DATA: switch_config.json carried two trees - .../links/... and .../data/... - that were byte-identical at 326 keys each, differing on exactly one value (crypto), which is how the drift got there. They are one tree now, for the same reason raw/trading_view_links and raw/trading_view_data share one PartitionsDefinition: the data step reads the link CSV its own leaf wrote, so they cannot legitimately disagree.
parameters.// ABSENT MEANS OFF: Same rule as the rest of this file. A leaf must say true to be enumerated; an asset class absent from this section enumerates nothing, and its asset would land an empty folder and fail on landed().

trading_view.// stocks: 21 sectors under vietnam/common_stock. This tree is also the UNIVERSE every CafeF/Simplize asset reads (links/stocks/).
trading_view.// funds: 4 fund types; ~21 HOSE ETFs come back from the etf leaf.
trading_view.// futures: 10 categories, vietnam only. Every leaf has returned 0 symbols since June - legitimately empty, not broken.
trading_view.// forex: 47 brokers, ~2,184 symbols. The big one: ~7-8 h at 4 browsers.
trading_view.// crypto: A LEAF, not a branch - no children in the tree, and its data adder is a stub. Queues 0 tasks; guarded in _add_crypto_links_tasks.
trading_view.// indices: 1 leaf. gold.indices was retired 2026-08-01; gold/stock_market covers the same six from CafeF.
trading_view.// bonds: 2 leaves. vietnam/corporate has been header-only since June.
trading_view.// economy: 209 leaves = 19 countries x 11 categories, ~3,850 series. Add a country here AND to COUNTRY_CODE in utils/enums.py - country_code() raises if it is missing, which is what stops an unfiltered global scrape.

run.// skip_existing: FALSE re-fetches every symbol (a real refresh). TRUE fetches only symbols absent from disk - right for RESUMING an interrupted run, wrong for refreshing.
run.// max_browsers: Hard cap on concurrent Chrome instances; also sizes the scraper's thread pool, so this IS the number of browsers. Overridable per shell with $env:SCRAPER_MAX_CONCURRENT_BROWSERS. 12 as of 2026-08-06 (constants.py default is 4); the 2026-08-06 economy LINKS run did 209 leaves in 16m43s at 10 with 0 failures. If leaves start coming back short, halve this first - a starved window is what truncated every leaf to 50 rows on 2026-08-05.
